Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5043; childless:--childless, without children.
BiblicalUsage: The Sadducees posed their riddle about the childless man who dies leaving his wife to his brother, and the word means without children. Jesus answered that the question itself misunderstands the resurrection.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Sadducees' trap failed because they could not imagine a life beyond this one, and the childless are not forgotten in the life to come.
